lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the pectoral fin; a central vertical column of three prominent spots is clearly discernible in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a regular grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible across the mid-flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with light intensity on the dorsal side and a corresponding shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of high-luminance spots, primarily localized toward the anterior leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an elongated symbiotic organism (remora) trailing beneath the ventral-lateral flank region.
